_meta.description: Experience database — delivery lessons for S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition (clean core). Grows with every pipeline run: the package step records new lessons via the record_experience tool. Compounding institutional knowledge.
_meta.note: Seed entries dated 2026-07-18 come from team delivery experience. Entries added by pipeline runs carry their run id in 'source'.

entries.topic: BAdI availability varies by release
entries.lesson: Never sign off an FD on a BAdI name from memory or old projects — S/4HANA Cloud gets 2 major releases a year and the Custom Logic app's BAdI list changes. Verify in the tenant's Custom Logic app before FD sign-off.

entries.topic: I_* naming does not equal released
entries.lesson: Some I_* CDS views are NOT C1-released for cloud development. Always verify the release contract in ADT Released Objects (or check_object_release_state), never by naming convention.

entries.topic: Custom field technical names are generated
entries.lesson: Custom Fields app generates technical names like YY1_PriorityLevel_PDH per business context. Do not hardcode them in designs before the field exists — reference the label and mark the technical name 'after creation'.
entries.impact: Avoids rework in BAdI code and API mappings

entries.topic: Run cloud ATC early, not at transport
entries.lesson: ATC with the cloud check variant runs at release of the transport anyway — running it early in ADT (Eclipse) per object saves whole review cycles. Treat abap_cloud_lint as the pre-gate and ATC as the tenant gate.

entries.topic: Transport paths differ per extensibility type
entries.lesson: Developer extensibility ships via git-based software components (Manage Software Components app); key-user artifacts ship via Export/Import Software Collection apps. Plan the cutover with BOTH paths — they are separate queues with separate approvers.

entries.topic: Custom Analytical Queries need analytics-released sources
entries.lesson: Key-user Custom Analytical Queries only work on analytics-enabled released CDS views (cubes/dimensions). Check the View Browser app for 'released for query' before promising a key-user report.

entries.topic: Check Fiori Apps Library before building any report
entries.lesson: A surprising number of 'custom report' requirements are covered by a standard embedded-analytics app. Check the Fiori Apps Library and in-tenant app finder before proposing custom development — fit-to-standard is rung 1 of the ladder.
entries.impact: Zero-cost solutions for ~20% of report FDs

entries.topic: Communication scenarios constrain auth methods
entries.lesson: Each communication scenario supports specific auth (basic / OAuth / certificate). Verify in the Communication Arrangements app early — middleware teams often assume OAuth where only basic+cert is offered, or vice versa.

entries.topic: Prefer events + deltas over polling full loads
entries.lesson: OData APIs are rate-limited and full extractions hurt tenant performance. Use business events (Event Mesh / Advanced Event Mesh) as triggers and changed-since $filter for deltas. Polling loops are a design smell in Public Cloud.

entries.topic: FI postings are SOAP, plan mapping effort
entries.lesson: Journal entry posting (and several FI scenarios) are SOAP services, not OData. CPI mapping effort for SOAP is typically higher — budget it in the estimate and check the WSDL on the Business Accelerator Hub.

entries.topic: Adobe Forms only — and Designer licensing
entries.lesson: Public Cloud output is Adobe Forms via Maintain Form Templates (no Smart Forms, no SAPscript, no print programs). XDP editing requires Adobe LiveCycle Designer — confirm the team has licenses BEFORE the form work starts; it has lead time and cost.

entries.topic: Flexible Workflow scenario list is the gate
entries.lesson: Flexible Workflow (key user, Manage Workflows app) only exists for SAP-delivered scenarios — check the scenario list in the tenant first. Anything beyond it goes to SAP Build Process Automation on BTP, which has consumption cost (see Discovery Center).
entries.impact: Correct mode + cost visibility for workflow FDs

entries.topic: Key-user BAdI ABAP is restricted — heavy logic goes developer
entries.lesson: The Custom Logic editor uses a restricted ABAP subset (limited data access, no reuse libraries). Validations/defaults are fine; anything with complex reads, reuse, or performance sensitivity belongs in developer extensibility (RAP/developer BAdI in ADT).

entries.topic: Validations fire on ALL channels
entries.lesson: A save-time BAdI validation fires for UI, API, and migration loads alike. Always test the API channel explicitly, and consider whether data loads (migration cockpit) should be exempted — they usually can't be, so time validations relative to cutover.
entries.impact: No blocked migration loads at cutover

entries.topic: Migration templates change per release
entries.lesson: Migrate Your Data staging templates are release-specific. Re-download templates after every tenant upgrade; old mapping sheets silently miss new mandatory fields.

entries.topic: Estimate BTP consumption before committing
entries.lesson: Every BTP service (Integration Suite, Event Mesh, SBPA, Build Work Zone, CAP runtime) has consumption pricing — check SAP Discovery Center service pages for metrics and estimator. Present the cost line in the solution proposal; a 'free' key-user alternative often wins on TCO.

entries.topic: Standard integration content first
entries.lesson: Before designing a custom iFlow, search the Business Accelerator Hub integration packs — SAP ships prebuilt integration content for many common third-party scenarios (banks, tax, logistics). Adapting standard content is cheaper and upgrade-safer than custom.

entries.topic: RAP on Eclipse ADT — test doubles are mandatory
entries.lesson: Developer extensibility is RAP + CDS in Eclipse ADT against the dev tenant. ABAP Unit with test doubles (CDS test double framework, released-API mocks) is required for the git release pipeline — design testability into the TD, not after.

entries.topic: No workaround exists for unreleased objects
entries.lesson: Embedded Steampunk cannot touch unreleased objects at all — not even read-only, no wrapper tricks. If a required object is unreleased: use a released alternative, request it from SAP via influence/customer request, or move the capability side-by-side over released APIs. Design around this from day one.

entries.topic: UI5/CAP on BTP is the report escape hatch — at a cost
entries.lesson: When key-user analytics and RAP list reports can't meet a UX requirement, a CAP + UI5 app on BTP (Build Work Zone entry) works — but it adds BTP runtime + Work Zone cost and a separate lifecycle. Rate it honestly against the simpler modes in the proposal.
entries.impact: Escape hatch used deliberately, not by default

entries.topic: RAP custom query + external API for classification filter (GRUPPOTECNICO)
entries.lesson: When a Fiori EL List Report needs to filter by SAP classification characteristic values, implement a RAP custom query class (if_rap_query_provider) that calls API_CLFN_PRODUCT_SRV via cl_web_http_client_manager to resolve the characteristic value to a product RANGE, then injects that range as an IN filter in the CDS SELECT. The value-help CDS (reads I_ClfnCharacteristic) handles the F4 help without any HTTP call. Comm scenario ID must be confirmed with Basis. /ui2/cl_json with REF TO data is fragile — prefer typed deserialization.

entries.topic: Blocked-stock App2 block-type derivation via config table (ZCORP_105BWART_T)
entries.lesson: Movement type to block-type mapping (E/D/L) belongs in a client-dependent config table (delivery class C), not hard-coded in CDS. The RAP query class reads ZCORP_105BWART_T at query time to build a movement-type RANGE, then filters stock rows by InventoryStockType (04=quality/blocked, 07=blocked stock) derived from block type. This makes the mapping configurable without code change. Custom movement types (9C1/9C2) must exist in tenant Customizing before integration testing.

entries.topic: RAP Custom Query stock aggregation pattern
entries.lesson: Move stock aggregation (SUM across InventoryStockTypes) to query class, not CDS join. INNER JOIN on I_MaterialStock_2 for a specific InventoryStockType excludes products that only have stock in other types. Confirmed fix: MRP-only CDS + SELECT SUM in query class with WHERE inventorystocktype IN ('01','02','07').

entries.topic: RAP Custom Query Provider — personnel number for IsAlreadyAssigned
entries.lesson: When IF_RAP_QUERY_PROVIDER~SELECT needs the current user's PersonnelNumber (e.g. to derive an IsAlreadyAssigned flag via LEFT OUTER JOIN on I_EngmtProjectTeamMember), resolve it via a workforce-person API call at the top of the SELECT method and catch CX_RAP_BUSINESS_ERROR non-fatally — a failed WA lookup means IsAlreadyAssigned=false for all rows, which is better than aborting the whole query. Extract the resolution logic into a shared helper class (ZCL_SS_WORKFORCE_HELPER pattern) so C2 action and C3 BAdI can reuse the same logic.

entries.topic: BAdI scaffold pattern for TV-9b unknowns — compile-safe skeleton with testable private logic
entries.lesson: When a BAdI implementation class cannot be fully coded because the BAdI interface name or method signature is unknown (tenant-verification item), separate the business logic into private methods that are independently compilable and unit-testable. The public BAdI method becomes a one-method scaffold with clear TV-n markers. This lets the rest of the package transport while the BAdI class waits for TV resolution, since it lives in a separate package (Z_SMART_SEARCH_BADI) and can be transported independently.

entries.topic: cl_abap_json field name casing in outbound API payloads
entries.lesson: cl_abap_json=>serialize lowercases ABAP component names by default. For outbound API calls where the target API expects PascalCase or specific casing (e.g. API_MANAGE_WORKFORCE_ASSIGNMENT), either rename the ty_payload components to match exactly or pass pretty_name=cl_abap_json=>pretty_mode-none. Always verify field name casing against the SAP Business Accelerator Hub API spec before activating the communication arrangement.

entries.topic: SELECT SINGLE non-determinism with multiple active Work Agreements
entries.lesson: SELECT SINGLE on I_PersonWorkAgreement filtered by date range is non-deterministic when multiple Work Agreements overlap (e.g. role transitions). Use SELECT ... ORDER BY ValidityStartDate DESCENDING UP TO 1 ROWS instead of SELECT SINGLE to guarantee the most-recently-started agreement is returned. This is ABAP Cloud compliant and avoids arbitrary row selection.

entries.topic: PBS scope (J12/1Q4) — all key objects are outside the offline catalog; budget pre-build verification
entries.lesson: For any FD covering Professional Services / PBS (scope items J12, 1Q4 or similar), assume that the engagement project CDS views, work package CDS views, Work Agreement API, Resource Assignment API, and timesheet BAdI are ALL NOT_VERIFIED in the offline catalog. Add a mandatory pre-build gate: (1) find PBS CDS view names on SAP Help Released CDS Views list, (2) confirm Work Agreement and Resource Assignment APIs on api.sap.com, (3) locate the timesheet BAdI in the SAP Help List of BAdIs under the PBS scope filter. Skipping this causes 4 NOT_VERIFIED findings, 6 open Major transport blockers, and a quality score below 50.
entries.impact: Prevents low quality scores and blocked transports on PBS deliverables

entries.topic: cx_static_check cannot use MESSAGE syntax in ABAP Cloud — use ev_error output parameter instead
entries.lesson: RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check MESSAGE ... does not compile in ABAP for Cloud Development because cx_static_check does not implement if_t100_message. Replace with an EXPORTING ev_error TYPE string output parameter: set ev_error = |...| and RETURN on error; callers check IF ev_error IS NOT INITIAL. This pattern is clean-core compliant and testable. Catches this at Gate 2 (Code Review) as a Critical finding if missed.
entries.impact: Avoids non-compiling Critical finding in code review

entries.topic: UI5 controller: encodeURIComponent does not escape apostrophes in an OData function URL
entries.lesson: When a UI5 controller calls a CAP function with fetch, it builds a URL like getOpenPurchaseOrders(supplierName='...'). Wrapping encodeURIComponent(value) in single quotes is NOT enough: encodeURIComponent leaves the apostrophe untouched (it is in the unreserved set). A supplier named O'Brien then sends unbalanced quotes and the request fails before it reaches the service, so server-side validation never runs. Fix: double the apostrophe first, then encode - encodeURIComponent(v.replace(/'/g, "''")). Apply it to every string parameter. This is a functional defect on the main search path, not a security hole (the server still uses bound query builders). Add a test that searches for a name containing an apostrophe.
entries.impact: A common real-world supplier name silently breaks the primary search in any UI5 app that calls an OData function with string parameters.

entries.topic: A silent row cap on a lookup breaks an "all matching records" acceptance criterion
entries.lesson: Capping an outbound lookup (for example .limit(50) on A_BusinessPartner for a name search) is correct defensive design - it stops a one-character search pulling the whole master. But if the cap is hit and the extra rows are dropped with no signal, the user sees a full-looking table and cannot tell records were left out. That fails any acceptance criterion worded "all matching X". A quiet partial answer is worse than an error in a report used for business decisions. Rule: whenever you cap a result set, detect the boundary (returned rows == cap) and surface a warning such as "More than 50 suppliers match. Narrow the name or enter a number." Add a boundary test. A cap the functional design explicitly accepted (here 500 purchase-order rows) does not need the warning.
entries.impact: Turns a hidden data-completeness bug into a visible, testable user message before it reaches procurement decisions.

entries.topic: Pure side-by-side runs: unset config beats a guessed value, and the ABAP lint gate has no input
entries.lesson: Two patterns from a pure side-by-side (BTP CAP + UI5) run on S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. (1) When a filter field or code value is not confirmed against tenant $metadata, do NOT code a guess. Make it an environment variable, validate it against a field-name pattern at start-up, and refuse to serve data until it is set. The gap stays visible instead of shipping wrong rows. (2) A side-by-side build contains zero ABAP, so the ABAP Cloud lint gate has no input. Record step 8 as "not applicable - no ABAP artifacts", list how each code block was classified (JSON, CDS, JavaScript, XML, YAML), and prove clean core by reading the build instead. A PASS on empty input is a false signal. (3) A communication scenario named in an FD often disagrees with the catalog - only the tenant Communication Arrangements app (F0763) settles it.
entries.impact: Keeps unconfirmed facts visible instead of hiding them behind a guessed constant or a meaningless lint PASS.
